rules.title: Oakland Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance - Grounds and Procedure
rules.requirement: A landlord may only terminate a tenancy for one of the specific just causes listed in the ordinance (e.g., owner move-in, substantial repairs, lease violation, Ellis Act withdrawal), must state the ground in the notice as the dominant motive, follow required notice periods, and file the notice with the Rent Board; failure to comply is a defense to eviction.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental units covered by the Oakland Rent Adjustment Program/Just Cause Ordinance; units exempted under O.M.C. Section 8.22.350 are not covered.
rules.exemptions: Units designated as exempt in O.M.C. Section 8.22.350; new state/federal eviction grounds must still conform to this chapter's procedural requirements.
rules.penalty: Failure to comply with notice, filing, or good-faith requirements is a defense to any unlawful detainer (eviction) action.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord shall not endeavor to recover possession of a rental unit unless at least one of the grounds enumerated in Subsection 6(A) [8.22.360 A] above is stated in the notice and that ground is the landlord's dominant motive for recovering possession and the landlord acts in good faith in seeking to recover possession.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is exempt under O.M.C. Section 8.22.350

rules.title: Oakland Relocation Payments for Withdrawal of Rental Units from Market
rules.requirement: Tenants who must move because an owner withdraws a rental unit from the rental market (Ellis Act withdrawal) are entitled to a relocation payment from the owner, with an additional payment for lower-income, elderly, disabled, or households with minor children.
rules.key_value: Relocation payment per amounts set forth in O.M.C. 8.22.820 A, plus additional payment under 8.22.820 B for qualifying households
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental units withdrawn from the rental market under O.M.C. Chapter 8.22, Article covering withdrawal of accommodations (Ellis Act withdrawals), excluding units exempt under 8.22.350.
rules.quoted_span: Tenant Households who are required to move as a result of t he Owner's withdrawal of the accommodation from rent or lease shall be entitled to a relocation payment from the Owner equal to Relocation Payment amounts set forth in O.M.C. 8.22.820 A.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is exempt under O.M.C. Section 8.22.350
